system.name: gist token-based context compression (empirical study)
system.one_liner: A study of gist-token context compression architectures, how well they replace full attention and how they fail, with two fixes.

content.variant_note: three sibling token-level schematics (a)-(c) reached through two question pills; the fourth combination is left out
content.argues: Gist compression architectures differ along two choices, memory location and gist granularity, which give three designs built from the same token grid.
content.subject: Full-attention token grid split into segments, two design questions, and three gist-token compression schematics with their attention lines.

lessons.what_to_learn: Turn a design space into a figure by chaining question pills whose coloured branch arrows lead to colour-matched sibling schematics, and reuse one token-grid drawing for every variant, changing only the special-token placement and the highlighted lines.
lessons.suits: Overviews of a family of architectures or strategies that differ along two or three design choices.

evidence: Overview of gist token-based context compression architectures.
mainly explore the remaining three combinations in this work, as illustrated in Figure 1.

summary: The paper studies gist token-based context compression: how well it can replace full attention and where it fails. Figure 1 maps the architectures. A full-attention token grid is split into segments; two question pills, Memory Location? and Gist Granularity?, joined by labelled coloured arrows, lead to three sibling schematics: (a) coarse-grained recurrent memory in purple, and (b) fine-grained and (c) coarse-grained KV cache in orange. Each schematic redraws the same grid of natural-token circles and gist-token squares over two segments, with grey attention fans, coloured lines for the maximum attention range, dashed boxes for retained gists and curved arrows carrying the cache forward.
summary_zh: 论文研究基于 gist 词元的上下文压缩。图先把全注意力词元网格切成段，再经「记忆位置？」「gist 粒度？」两个问题节点，用彩色分支引向三种并列方案：粗粒度循环记忆（紫）、细粒度与粗粒度 KV 缓存（橙），每种都画出词元与注意力线。
notes: The index counted 3 panels and the prior pass 4; the blue input frame is separately framed but untitled and is counted as a fourth panel with label null. The 28 bitmaps in the digest appear to be thin gradient strips (shading of the attention fans) and the two lightbulb icons, not data pictures. The paper text says only three of the four combinations are explored; the fourth is not drawn.
